notes.content: Thank you for your interest in CSU Dominguez Hills! This articulation agreement displays lower-division course requirements specific to this major. Students are advised to meet with an academic counselor when planning to transfer to CSU Dominguez Hills and refer to the University Catalog to learn more about this major and its features. Detailed admissions requirements for transfer students are available on the CSUDH campus website . Completion of Statutory Requirements (United States History, Constitution and American Ideals) is a baccalaureate degree requirement for the California State University system and may be met prior to transfer with eligible California Community College (CCC) courses designated as US-1, US-2, and US-3. Completion of Statutory Requirements prior to transfer is most advantageous and strongly encouraged as a number of CCC courses that meet this requirement might also double-count for General Education.
notes.contentHtml: Thank you for your interest in CSU Dominguez Hills! This articulation agreement displays lower-division course requirements specific to this major. Students are advised to meet with an academic counselor when planning to transfer to CSU Dominguez Hills and refer to the University Catalog to learn more about this major and its features. Detailed admissions requirements for transfer students are available on the CSUDH campus website. Completion of Statutory Requirements (United States History, Constitution and American Ideals) is a baccalaureate degree requirement for the California State University system and may be met prior to transfer with eligible California Community College (CCC) courses designated as US-1, US-2, and US-3. Completion of Statutory Requirements prior to transfer is most advantageous and strongly encouraged as a number of CCC courses that meet this requirement might also double-count for General Education.

notes.content: Students transferring from an articulating community college should have completed three semesters of calculus (through differential and integral calculus of several variables), two semesters of calculus-based physics and one semester of general chemistry. If those students have not had an introduction to modern physics and/or mathematical physics, they must take PHY 134 and PHY 306 as soon as possible upon arrival at CSUDH. General Chemistry articulation is approved as a sequence only. For this major, CHE 112 General Chemistry II is not required.
